summary: Bit Origin Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting entry into an Asset Purchase Agreement to acquire AI computing assets (16 NVIDIA Blackwell B300 AI servers, related service and colocation agreements) from PT Mitra Manunggal Sangkara, an Indonesian seller. Consideration is $1 million cash plus a pre-funded warrant to purchase 6,457,863 Class A ordinary shares valued at $10 million (exercise price $0.00006/share). The filing does not state a board recommendation or advisor. The APA includes customary indemnification with a $100,000 basket and $1 million cap, governed by Singapore law with SIAC arbitration. What to watch: risk-arb focuses on delivery of in-transit assets and regulatory consents for assignment of third-party contracts.
